contracts.detail: New `const char *incremental_base` parameter added to `write_midx_file_only` (position 4, before flags) and `write_midx_file_compact` (position 3, before flags). This is an API_SIGNATURE_CHANGE — existing callers with positional arguments will break. In-tree callers have been updated. External consumers of midx.h would need to pass NULL for default behavior.

conclusion.rationale: The API_SIGNATURE_CHANGE is confirmed: both write_midx_file_only and write_midx_file_compact gained a new `incremental_base` parameter. However, midx.h is an internal header in the git project — practical external consumers are rare. The new parameter is NULL-able (callers can pass NULL), and all in-tree callers have been updated. The existing test suites (t5334, t5335) pass 100% and gcov confirms 100% patch-line coverage on executable C code. The change is additive (new --base CLI option) with no breaking changes to existing defaults. The CLI behavior is backwards compatible. The API signature change is real (would break compilation for any external caller), but such callers are uncommon. Overall assessment: backward_compatibility is 'inconclusive' because the API signature change is technically breaking, but in practice the risk is very low and the new behavior is fully tested.
recommended_actions: Verify no external projects link against git's internal libgit.a and call write_midx_file_only/write_midx_file_compact directly
The --base CLI option is fully backwards compatible (additive, no existing behavior changes)
